final: WITH team_averages AS (SELECT team_id, 1.0 * SUM(w) / COUNT(DISTINCT year) AS average_wins, AVG(1.0 * (g - l) / NULLIF(l, 0)) AS average_games_minus_losses_over_losses FROM manager_half GROUP BY team_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_wins) AS mean_average_wins FROM team_averages) SELECT team_id, average_wins, average_games_minus_losses_over_losses, average_wins - mean_average_wins AS gap FROM team_averages CROSS JOIN overall WHERE average_wins > mean_average_wins ORDER BY gap DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
